name: DIMENSION4L
source:
Victoria and Claire’s ordinary days are turned upside down when a mysterious girl named Cerbera appears in Crowsmere. Her strange powers and cryptic questions pull them into a hidden world of magic, secrets, and danger. 

As they follow her through the city and beyond, every step reveals new mysteries – and forces them to confront truths they never imagined.

[From [url=https://kartsuli.itch.io/dimension4l]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当一个名叫塞贝拉的神秘女孩出现在克劳斯米尔时，维多利亚和克莱尔的日常生活发生了翻天覆地的变化。她奇怪的力量和神秘的问题将他们带入一个充满魔法、秘密和危险的隐藏世界。

当他们跟随她穿越城市并超越时，每一步都揭示了新的谜团 - 并迫使他们面对他们从未想象过的真相。

[来自[url=https://kartsuli.itch.io/dimension4l]Itch.io[/url]]
